sources.entry: crawl4ai - An open-source, LLM-friendly web crawler that provides lightning-fast, structured data extraction specifically designed for AI agents.

summary.one_liner: Crawl4AI is an open-source Python web crawler that turns websites into LLM-ready Markdown and structured data, with an optional hosted cloud service.
use_cases: Convert web pages to clean Markdown for RAG pipelines
Feed live web content to an AI agent
Extract product or listing fields from pages into JSON
Crawl a whole site with breadth-first or best-first strategies
Scrape JavaScript-heavy pages with a real browser
Capture screenshots or PDFs of pages
notable: Adaptive crawler that stops once it has learned enough to answer a query
Fit Markdown filters that strip menus, footers and boilerplate
CSS, XPath and regex extraction without an LLM
Optional hosted cloud with search, SERP and answer endpoints
Self-hosted REST API and MCP server for AI agents
caveats: Browser-based crawling requires installing Chromium through Playwright setup
LLM extraction needs your own LLM provider key
Cloud features such as search, SERP and answers are paid or limited by credits; the free tier is capped at 10 requests a minute
Docker server requires an API token to serve requests beyond its container
